widget.name: Client cache
widget.description: Automatic client cache: when a page opens again, data loads that only read come from memory for a few seconds. Anything the user does on an open page gets fresh data. Put it on the layouts; nothing else to set up.

property.caption: Enabled
property.description: False: every call goes to the server (the cache is cleared).

property.caption: Mode
property.description: Automatic: no list needed. Page-open loads of microflows that return data and only read are cached; a microflow that ever writes or shows a message is never cached again; any microflow call on an open page clears the cache. List: only the microflows in the list below.

property.caption: Keep answers (s)
property.description: Automatic mode: how long a page-open answer may be reused (1 to 600).

property.caption: Use the cache for
property.description: Page opens (recommended): only the loads right after a page opens or the user goes back come from the cache; a tap on an open page (for example a refresh button, also in a pop-up) always gets fresh data. Always: every listed call within the time limit.

property.caption: Page open window (ms)
property.description: How long after a page opens its loads may use the cache (500 to 10000).

property.caption: Clear the cache
property.description: Safest: whenever a microflow that is not in the list runs (it may save data on the server or call a REST POST/PUT). Writes only: when an answer shows a commit, delete or new object (more hits, but a REST write without a Mendix commit is not seen).

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: Only on writes seen in answers

property.caption: Diagnostic mode
property.description: Shows a small Cache label on the page: tap it for hits, misses and the microflow calls seen (with operationId, time, size, clean read). Turn off before release.

property.caption: Exceptions (optional, normally empty)
property.description: Leave empty: automatic mode needs nothing. Only if a microflow must never be cached: turn on Diagnostic mode, open the screen, tap the Cache label and copy the newest id, then write id=0 here. id=60 keeps it 60 s. List mode: only the ids here are cached.
